items.verdict: met (cycle 10); 99th-percentile cap not applied, revisit if needed

items.title: Parent-account roll-up: confirm UI, cross-brand card
Deal contact linked by Pipedrive person id
items.verdict: ids linked and empty lists hidden (cycle 10); phones/emails need the People export

PDF export of proposals
PM renewal pipeline from agreement anniversaries
Cycle 10–11 defect fixes: proposal age, stuck list, multi-brand definition, lost buckets, parent integrity
Weekly pipeline snapshots for durable trends
items.why: Week movement depends on SalesDesk timestamps imported deals lack; the CEO needs a trend that survives cutover.
items.acceptance: product/snap-YYYY-Www written once per ISO week on first management render (keys open, weighted, wonFY, byBrand, byRep, byStage, stuck, dq); Analytics › Multi-year 'Pipeline trend' reads snaps; weekMovement() uses the prior snap when stageAt is empty.
items.verdict: met (cycle 14, test13.js); first live snapshot seeded for 2026-W44

items.title: Won date and stage timestamps from the next export; performance indexes
items.why: Proposal medians stay approximate until Won time is imported; indexes keep 7,000+ deals fast on phones.
items.acceptance: importer maps 'Won time'/'Lost time'/'Last stage change' to wonDate/lostDate/stageChangedAt; S.dealsByOrg index; home, pipeline list, accounts list, analytics overview each < 120 ms headless at 1400px; all suites green.
items.verdict: met (cycle 14): import stamps mapped; dealsByOrg index; renders 8–54 ms headless

items.title: Commit / best-case forecast by rep and brand
items.why: A CRO cannot run a forecast call on a stage-weighted number alone.
items.acceptance: forecastCat on deals (commit|best|pipeline|omit, default from stage); window.forecastRoll({month}) rows {rep,brand,commit,best,wgt,plan,gap}; Forecast tab columns; CEO brief 'Commit this month vs plan' line; sales sees own rep only.

items.title: Forecast accuracy from snapshots
items.why: Commit discipline sticks only when last week's commit meets what booked.
items.acceptance: forecastAccuracy() {rep,committed,won,hit} from >=2 snaps; Analytics card; honest empty state with <2 snaps.

items.title: Bid calendar (bidDue)
items.why: Estimators run their week by bid due dates; capture from day one and map on import.
items.acceptance: bidDue editable in quick log and deal edit; Home 'Bids due this week'; past-due bid without a quote shows a red pill; list sortable by bidDue; importer maps 'Bid due date'.

items.title: GM sign-off for below-floor bids
items.why: GPMD becomes culture when a below-floor bid cannot go out without a brand GM's name on it.
items.acceptance: sales setting a below-floor quote to sent leaves draft + approvalRequested; brandmgr approveQuote/declineQuote; proposal download blocked until approved; Home mgmt card 'Bids awaiting GPMD approval'; approvals logged; above-floor unaffected.

items.title: Quote-from-hours with real cost lines and estimator field
items.why: A one-line implied lot cannot be edited into a real estimate; 239 deals already name an estimator.
items.acceptance: quoteFromHours yields labor/material/equipment/sub lines summing to the same implied cost, GPMD within $1; estimator on quote and proposal; Quotes filter 'mine as estimator'.

items.title: PM renewal pipeline (shipped day 1 as P34)
items.verdict: met (cycle 12); night 3 adds 30/60/90 buckets and a CEO brief renewal line

items.title: Data-quality dashboard by brand and rep
items.why: No GM trusts a report until they can see what is missing and who owns it.
items.acceptance: dqSummary() {brand,rep,counts,score}; Analytics › Quality with deep links; totals reconcile to Home Needs attention; sales sees own rows.

items.title: Won-deal handoff export to ServiceTitan / Intacct
items.why: Won deals must land in the job system without retyping.
items.acceptance: stJobNo + enteredInST on deal; Setup › Data CSV export of won deals in range (downloads); Home mgmt card 'Won, not in ServiceTitan: n'.

items.title: Email-to-deal logging (paste .eml text)
items.why: Email is where half of selling happens; without it the activity count lies.
items.acceptance: parseEmail(text) {from,to,date,subject,body} on two fixtures; logs type 'email' activity counted by weekMovement; contact matched by email.

items.title: Performance at 7,000+ deals (virtualised tables, indexes)
items.why: Full-table renders will be felt on phones as history grows.
items.acceptance: lists render 200 rows + show more; home, pipeline list, accounts list, analytics overview each <120ms headless; all suites green.

items.title: Rep onboarding and training mode
items.why: Abandoning Pipedrive is a habit change; a guided first session beats a manual.
items.acceptance: training deals d_training_* excluded from kpis, weekMovement, ceoBriefData, snaps, exports; tour sets meUser.onboardedAt; Team shows onboarded.

items.title: Accessibility pass (WCAG 2.1 AA)
items.why: Keyboard-only estimators and dark-mode phones must read every pill and move a stage.
items.acceptance: axe-core 0 serious/critical on home, pipeline, deal, quote, proposal at 1400/400 light/dark; keyboard stage move; aria-live toasts.
items.verdict: met (cycle 24, test22.js: axe 0 serious/critical across 10 view/theme combinations)

items.title: Service-address territory map (stretch)
items.why: Only 36 deals carry addresses today.
items.acceptance: static SVG dot map from a geocoded CSV upload; drop if coverage <200 deals.
items.verdict: Retired by PM review: 36 addressed deals, below the 200-deal threshold.

items.title: Fresh Pipedrive export (Deals, Notes, People, Activities) through Setup › Data
items.why: 647 open deals created since June have no stage names, contacts, proposal dates or hours; every contact lacks a phone.
items.acceptance: Owner action; importer is ready.

items.title: Brand palettes as named tokens from the brand skills; rep detail modal
items.why: CEO direction mid-day: branding must be straight out of the skills with no generic colour names; clicking a rep must show bids and details.
items.acceptance: Every brand has named tokens with source and fonts; Setup shows them; proposal uses token roles; rep modal with open bids, won, lost reasons, plan attainment, commit; links everywhere.

items.title: Published live-data snapshot so direct visits show all data
items.why: CEO direction: data must be present when the artifact is opened as a plain website, where the shared database is unavailable.
items.acceptance: data/live.json published beside the page with every collection; loaded under local edits when db is null; rail badge shows snapshot date; nightly build refreshes it.

items.title: Scope-consistent forecast and CEO brief
items.why: The Friday forecast call is the first place a GM catches SalesDesk disagreeing with itself: brand filter shows platform plan and every other brand's reps.
items.acceptance: S.ui.brand='cortez' → Forecast header plan = sum of Cortez goals for the month; no non-Cortez rows; no rows matching /new hire|mgmt/i; sales role → only own row; ceoBriefText commit/plan equals forecastRoll({month,deals:ds,brand}); existing suites green.

items.title: Rollout-safe permissions
items.why: 73 reps must neither be locked out nor able to edit each other's deals on day one.
items.acceptance: Every deal-mutating action calls canEditDeal (saveQuickLog, newQuote/saveQuote, startRenewal, saveHandoff); AI tools and repModal use filteredDeals(); permission_denied on admin collections never flips the session to view-only (done, cycle 26); uid link falls back to signins for non-admins (done, cycle 26); test stubs S.db to throw permission_denied and asserts the role stays writable.
items.source: PM review 10-30; verified against the hosted API

items.title: One outlier/paused guard everywhere
items.why: $6.2B at the top of Accounts destroys trust in every other total.
items.acceptance: A sane(d) helper used by recompute roll-ups, account page header, Team counts and multi-year; Accounts first row is not the $6.2B Weber outlier's org; 'Last' renamed 'Last touch' and derived from lastActivityAt||close.

items.title: Brand forecast roll-up with week-over-week delta
items.why: The CRO runs the call by brand, not 60 rep rows.
items.acceptance: Forecast tab adds a brand table (won, commit, best, weighted, plan, gap) above rep rows; delta columns vs prevSnapshot().commitByRep; totals equal rep-row sums within $1.

items.title: Pipedrive parity check for cutover
items.why: 'No loss of trust in the numbers' needs a visible reconciliation against the last import.
items.acceptance: Setup › Data card compares open count/value and won FY by brand against totals stored at import; flags any brand off by >1%; headless test imports a 3-row fixture and sees the card update.

items.title: GM month-end pack
items.why: GMs will otherwise rebuild it in Excel from Pipedrive.
items.acceptance: gmPackText(brand): won vs plan, bids sent with GPMD and below-floor approvals with reasons, renewals 90d, DQ score, stuck proposals; Copy button on Home for brandmgr; numbers equal the cards.

items.title: Hosted web app on an FSP domain with Microsoft sign-in
items.why: CEO direction: a real site to send people to, behind Microsoft login. Reps cannot be sent to a claude.ai artifact.
items.acceptance: deploy/azure-swa: Static Web App + Entra ID (tenant-locked) + Functions API + Cosmos DB; same page via shim; headless end-to-end green for owner, sales (name-matched, uid linked) and guest viewer; runbook in deploy/azure-swa/README.md. Owner action: run infra/deploy.sh, add DNS CNAME, push repo.

items.title: Pipedrive font styling and icons
items.why: CEO direction: reps should feel at home on day one.
items.acceptance: Source Sans 3 UI face, 14 px base, 600 headings, sentence-case pills and labels, thin rounded line icons; axe and regression suites green.

items.title: Weighted forecast: stage-weighted vs imported probability, with disagreement flag
items.why: dealProb prefers the October Pipedrive probability on 880 of 953 open deals and 196 contradict the stage shown; the board number is wrong until this is explicit.
items.acceptance: Setting toggles the weighting basis; Quality counts |prob − stage.p| > 0.2; header states which basis is in use.
items.verdict: met (cycle 29, test24.js) — the "probability ≠ stage" check was dropped as redundant with Stage conflict

items.title: Close-date slips recorded and surfaced
items.why: Sandbagging is invisible without a slip history.
items.acceptance: closeHistory appended on every close-date change; 'Slipped' rows on This week, CEO brief and Forecast per rep; test moves a date twice and sees two entries.

items.title: Proposal: equipment schedule, lead time, warranty; print-ready PDF path
items.why: Hospital facilities directors do not accept an .html attachment; six-figure bids need an equipment schedule.
items.acceptance: Project proposals list equipment lines as a schedule; Lead time and Warranty sections from quote fields; downloaded HTML carries print CSS with page breaks and a 'Save as PDF' note; proposal doc renders in all 9 brands without overflow.

items.title: GPMD floors must be set per brand before verdicts show
items.why: Every brand inherits the $850 default, so Cortez's verdict is fiction today.
items.acceptance: Quotes page banner until the brand's GPMD is explicitly set; Setup › GPMD shows 'inherits default' badges; verdict pill shows 'default floor' tooltip until set.

items.title: Two-step quick log and lighter quote line editor on phones
items.why: Seven fields on a 400 px phone is too many; the line editor becomes a thumb fight.
items.acceptance: Quick log shows type + text + next date first, 'More' reveals stage/close/forecast; quote lines collapse to a card per line under 600 px; freight line type added; axe green.

items.title: Proposal rebuilt as a letter-format brand document
items.why: CEO direction mid-day: the proposals need a lot more work; a web-page cover is not what a facilities director signs.
items.acceptance: Letterhead per brand skills, prepared-for and details blocks, numbered sections incl. existing conditions, equipment schedule, investment with alternates and payment, schedule, warranty, acceptance with full signature blocks; renders in all brands at phone width; prints to letter PDF.

items.title: Email from the deal and inbox sync through Microsoft 365
items.why: CEO direction: reps must email from the tool and have customer emails connect to the opportunity.
items.acceptance: Send via the viewer's Outlook with the deal tag; sync files tagged/contact emails as activities; graceful per-code errors; hidden without the connector.
items.verdict: met for the claude.ai artifact (cycle 34, test29.js); hosted build needs Microsoft Graph (P70)

items.title: Estimator spreadsheet import on Quotes
items.why: CEO direction: estimators already price in Excel; retyping lines into a quote will not happen.
items.acceptance: xlsx/csv/paste; header and column detection with override; type inference; labor hours → man-days; totals skipped; sheet total as price; quote created with import note.

items.title: Hosted build: email send and inbox sync via Microsoft Graph
items.why: The Azure version has no claude.ai connector; the same two actions need Graph with the user's token.
items.acceptance: SWA login requests Mail.Send and Mail.Read; API endpoints /api/mail/send and /api/mail/search call Graph with the forwarded token; shim exposes them as the mcp capability so the page code is unchanged; mock server fakes Graph for test_web.js.
items.verdict: met (cycle 36): api/src/functions/mail.js over Microsoft Graph app permissions; shim emulates the connector; test_web.js sends and syncs through the mock. Needs admin consent + Exchange application access policy at deploy.

items.title: Shared intake mailbox (sales@brand) auto-filing
items.why: Emails to the tool without a tag: a shared mailbox reps cc, swept nightly and matched to deals by contact and tag.
items.acceptance: Admin sets a shared mailbox per brand; sync reads it (mailboxOwnerEmail) and files by tag or contact; unmatched go to a review list.
items.verdict: met (cycle 38, test32.js); needs delegated access to each shared mailbox for whoever runs the sync

items.title: Proposal pass two: equipment data, all-in pricing, qualifications, schedule, warranty table, cover letter
items.why: Facilities-director review: a CFO must see what is bought, what it costs all-in and why this contractor.
items.acceptance: Equipment fields on quote lines render as a data schedule; tax and totals per option; clarifications for permits/tax/bond; milestone table; warranty by component; brand profile drives qualifications/insurance/references; cover letter; all 10 brands render, prints to PDF.
items.verdict: met (cycle 35, test26.js); next: nameplate photos, dated schedule from acceptance date, e-signature
